newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF to extend rate contract pit trading hours.
newsitem.headline: MATIF to extend rate contract pit trading hours.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF SA said on Wednesday that from March 17 pit-trading for all interest rate futures and options contracts will start at 0730 GMT and finish at 1530 GMT.
MATIF also said it planned to test an extension of pit-trading for its interest rate contracts to 1630 GMT but did not give any timetable.
The changes mean French franc and Ecu long bond futures and options contracts will start pit-trading half an hour earlier and PIBOR futures and options will finish half an hour later then before.
